diffusion.label: Bounded logistic diffusion scenarios
diffusion.comment: Per-LAD logistic curves (rate, midpoint) fitted to the quarterly matched-scope adoption share (VEH0132 private BEV / VEH0105 private licensed vehicles, all body types), recency-weighted, shrunk toward the Wales anchor; one shared midpoint shift per scenario sets the capacity-weighted Wales share at 2045 Q4 to the scenario target. Counts are share x latest VEH0105 private stock held fixed. See notebook Stage 6.
diffusion.citation: Companion notebook to "Predicting EV adoption in Wales using Semantic Knowledge Graph" (manuscript, 2026), Stage 6 (bounded logistic scenario fit) and Stage 15 (Prediction KG export); paper S2.3.6, S3.4.3, S3.5.

neural.label: Scenario-constrained neural and graph neural forecasts
neural.comment: Stages 6e, 13 and 14 of the companion notebook, quarterly revision (paper S2.3.2-S2.3.4, S3.4.1, Tables 5-7). A multilayer perceptron (quarter index -> level), a scenario-constrained perceptron (quarter index and capacity K as inputs), a two-layer graph convolutional network over a 22-node LAD similarity graph, its scenario-constrained variant, a persistence-plus-drift baseline (last value plus the mean quarterly change over the preceding four quarters) and the bounded logistic of Stage 13 are evaluated on one quarterly LAD panel extracted from the released KG by SPARQL (Listing 1) under a single rolling-origin one-step-ahead protocol: every quarter from 2022 Q1 to the end of the panel is held out in turn, the model trains on everything before it, only LADs with at least eight training quarters enter a fold, giving 352 held-out LAD-quarters per configuration for both targets (private BEV keepership, VEH0132; public charging devices, EVCI9001). Scenario capacity follows the revised Equation 2, K = alpha x the last TRAINING observation with alpha = 6 (low), 10 (central) and 15 (high), so no post-training value enters any fit. Mean R2 is the mean of per-LAD R2; pooled R2 over all held-out LAD-quarters is reported alongside. Stage 6e additionally trains a small feed-forward network on the quarterly matched-scope adoption ratio and scores it on first differences against persistence and linear drift. Charger counts are excluded as adoption features. The printed notebook tables give evaluation metrics only; no network forecast to 2045 is produced, the bounded logistic remains the forecasting instrument.
neural.citation: Companion notebook to "Predicting EV adoption in Wales using Semantic Knowledge Graph" (manuscript, 2026), Stages 6e, 13, 14; paper S2.3.2-S2.3.4, S3.4.1 (Tables 5-7). Values taken from: companion notebook cell outputs: CLEETS_EV_Adoption_Wales_Quarterly.ipynb.
neural.activity_label: Scenario-constrained neural and graph neural forecasts

charging.label: Charging-provision constraint (2045)
charging.comment: Stage 8, research question 2 of the companion notebook. Each LAD's 2045 BEV count from the turnover trajectory is set against public charging devices grown at 5% a year for 20 years ('slow' scenario) and a benchmark of 20 BEVs per public device. LADs that diffuse slowly AND fall short of the benchmark are classed as 'charging plausibly binding'; the rest as 'provision will bind later'. Sensitivity: frozen, slow and sustained (12%/yr) charger growth all leave every LAD below the benchmark. Assumption-driven; not an official forecast.
charging.citation: Companion notebook to "Predicting EV adoption in Wales using Semantic Knowledge Graph" (manuscript, 2026), Stage 8; paper Discussion (charging provision), Stage 8 outputs. Values taken from: companion notebook cell outputs: CLEETS_EV_Adoption_Wales_Quarterly.ipynb.

hierarchical.label: Hierarchical diffusion (two-stage empirical Bayes)
hierarchical.comment: Stage 11 of the companion notebook (paper S2.3.6, S3.5, Table 9, Figures 4-5). Each LAD's logistic curve is fitted independently, the fitted rate and midpoint are meta-regressed on standardised covariates (population density, population) with a DerSimonian-Laird between-LAD variance, and each LAD is shrunk toward its covariate prediction in proportion to how noisily it was estimated. Evaluated on first differences of the adoption share. Outputs: per-LAD midpoint period, rate per quarter, 95% interval width, shrinkage weight and lag against the Welsh median.
hierarchical.citation: Companion notebook to "Predicting EV adoption in Wales using Semantic Knowledge Graph" (manuscript, 2026), Stage 11; paper S2.3.6, S3.5 (Table 9, Figures 4-5). Values taken from: companion notebook cell outputs: CLEETS_EV_Adoption_Wales_Quarterly.ipynb.

covariates.label: Cross-sectional covariate comparison
covariates.comment: Stages 4a-bis and 5 of the companion notebook (paper S3.4.2, Table 8). Node features per LAD (population, population density, land area; chargers and EV counts are extracted but charger features are excluded from the predictors) are used to predict EVs per 1,000 residents at the target quarter with a mean baseline, Ridge, Random Forest, Extra Trees, GCN, GAT and GraphSAGE under leave-one-out evaluation over the 22 LADs, stochastic models refit under five seeds. The seed spread is at least as large as the gap between the best model and the mean baseline, so no single winning architecture is reported. Ridge residuals rank which LADs adopt above or below what population, density and area alone would predict.
covariates.citation: Companion notebook to "Predicting EV adoption in Wales using Semantic Knowledge Graph" (manuscript, 2026), Stages 4a-bis, 5; paper S3.4.2 (Table 8). Values taken from: companion notebook cell outputs: CLEETS_EV_Adoption_Wales_Quarterly.ipynb.

turnover.label: Age-structured fleet turnover, 2032 phase-out
turnover.comment: Stages 7-9 of the companion notebook (paper S2.3.5, S3.6, S3.8, Table 10, Figures 6-7). New non-BEV private registrations decline linearly to zero by 2032 Q4 and all replacement registrations are BEV from 2033 Q1; each LAD's private vehicle stock is held at its latest VEH0105 value; vehicles retire under a Weibull survival curve calibrated on median scrappage age (12, 14 and 16 years; central 14) rather than a constant hazard, and the observed BEV vintages are carried forward cohort by cohort to 2053 Q4. The result is a ceiling, not a forecast: it assumes every new private vehicle from the ban onward is a BEV. Outputs: BEV share at 2045 Q4 and 2053 Q4, residual non-BEV stock, and the first quarter at which 95%, 99% and 99.5% BEV share is reached.
turnover.citation: Companion notebook to "Predicting EV adoption in Wales using Semantic Knowledge Graph" (manuscript, 2026), Stages 7-9; paper S2.3.5, S3.6, S3.8 (Table 10, Figures 6-7). Values taken from: companion notebook cell outputs: CLEETS_EV_Adoption_Wales_Quarterly.ipynb.
turnover.activity_label: Age-structured fleet turnover under a 2032 new-sales phase-out

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#Observation
ontology_terms.label: CLEETS observation
ontology_terms.comment: An observation concerning electric vehicle adoption, charging infrastructure, socioeconomic conditions or a related indicator.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#Time
ontology_terms.label: CLEETS time entity
ontology_terms.comment: A temporal entity used to identify the period associated with a CLEETS observation.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#Quarter
ontology_terms.label: Calendar quarter
ontology_terms.comment: A three-month calendar reporting interval.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#AdoptionRatioObservation
ontology_terms.label: Electric vehicle adoption-ratio observation
ontology_terms.comment: An observation reporting the relationship between electric vehicle keepership and charging infrastructure.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#EVChargerCount
ontology_terms.label: Electric vehicle charger-count observation
ontology_terms.comment: An observation reporting the number of electric vehicle charging devices for an area and reporting period.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#EVKeepership
ontology_terms.label: Electric vehicle keepership observation
ontology_terms.comment: An observation reporting the number of registered electric vehicle keepers for an area and reporting period.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#EnglishLAD
ontology_terms.label: English local authority district
ontology_terms.comment: A local authority district in England, including unitary authorities, metropolitan and non-metropolitan districts and London boroughs.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#IncomeDeprivation
ontology_terms.label: Income-deprivation observation
ontology_terms.comment: An observation reporting an income-deprivation measure for an area and reporting period.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#LAD
ontology_terms.label: Local authority district
ontology_terms.comment: A UK local authority district or equivalent administrative area.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#ObservableProperty
ontology_terms.label: Observable property
ontology_terms.comment: A property that can be observed in a CLEETS observation.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#Population
ontology_terms.label: Population
ontology_terms.comment: Resident population associated with a geographic area.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#PopulationDensity
ontology_terms.label: Population Density
ontology_terms.comment: Population per unit area.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#WelshLAD
ontology_terms.label: Welsh local authority district
ontology_terms.comment: A principal local authority area in Wales.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#quarter
ontology_terms.label: calendar quarter number
ontology_terms.comment: The quarter number of a calendar year.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#year
ontology_terms.label: calendar year
ontology_terms.comment: The calendar year associated with a reporting period, as a four-digit integer. xsd:gYear is deliberately avoided: it is outside the OWL 2 datatype map and is rejected by HermiT.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#chargerCountValue
ontology_terms.label: charger-count value
ontology_terms.comment: The number of electric vehicle charging devices reported by a charger-count observation.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#chargersPerKeeper
ontology_terms.label: chargers-per-keeper value
ontology_terms.comment: The number of charging devices divided by the number of electric vehicle keepers for the same area and period. Reciprocal of cleets:keeperChargerRatio and recorded only where a source reports it directly.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#densityValue
ontology_terms.label: densityValue
ontology_terms.comment: Population density in persons per square kilometre.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#hasSimpleResult
ontology_terms.label: has simple result
ontology_terms.comment: Links an observation to a literal result value.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#deprivationDecile
ontology_terms.label: income-deprivation decile
ontology_terms.comment: The decile assigned to an area by the relevant deprivation index, where 1 denotes the most deprived tenth.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#incomeDeprivationValue
ontology_terms.label: income-deprivation value
ontology_terms.comment: A numeric income-deprivation value reported for an area.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#keeperChargerRatio
ontology_terms.label: keepers-per-charger value
ontology_terms.comment: The number of electric vehicle keepers divided by the number of charging devices for the same area and period.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#keepershipValue
ontology_terms.label: keepership value
ontology_terms.comment: The number of registered electric vehicle keepers reported by a keepership observation.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#ladCode
ontology_terms.label: local authority district code
ontology_terms.comment: The official statistical code assigned to a local authority district, for example W06000015.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#populationValue
ontology_terms.label: populationValue
ontology_terms.comment: Population count.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#yearQuarter
ontology_terms.label: year-quarter label
ontology_terms.comment: A human-readable year-quarter label, such as 2025-Q4.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#forLAD
ontology_terms.label: for local authority district
ontology_terms.comment: Links a CLEETS observation to the local authority district to which it applies. Functional: an observation reports one district.

ontology_terms.subject: https://w3id.org/def/cleets#forTime
ontology_terms.label: for observation period

activity.label: Bounded logistic diffusion scenario fit
activity.comment: Per-LAD logistic curves (rate, midpoint) fitted to the quarterly matched-scope adoption share (VEH0132 private BEV / VEH0105 private licensed vehicles, all body types), recency-weighted, shrunk toward the Wales anchor; one shared midpoint shift per scenario sets the capacity-weighted Wales share at 2045 Q4 to the scenario target. Counts are share x latest VEH0105 private stock held fixed. See notebook Stage 6.
